title.en: Third-Person Lock-On Sword and Shield: Boss Trials

view.en: Third-person 3D: the camera is behind the green-clad swordsman and follows the boss or lock target. The HUD shows the boss health bar, your life and this fight item; ground warnings appear on the arena floor.

goal.en: Empty the boss health bar to win; you lose if your life reaches zero. There is a time limit and a timeout is not a win. Life does not regenerate.

mouse.en: Mouse movement turns the camera; when unlocked, vertical movement adjusts aiming pitch. Q / E also turn the camera 45° at a time.

keys.en: roll / jump: unlocked = directional roll (invulnerable mid-roll); locked: forward or still = jump slash, back = back hop, left/right = side hop
lock-on: hold to lock the nearest target; you face and track it
sword slash; tap repeatedly for a three-hit combo
hold to raise the shield and block frontal attacks; the mirrored shield absorbs blasts
use this fight item (auto-aims at the target when locked)

notes.en: While Shift is held you always face the target and the item auto-aims; movement stays camera-relative.
Rolling is invulnerable mid-roll; when locked, Space becomes a jump slash, back hop or side hop.
The shield blocks only frontal attacks; blasts cannot be blocked, only absorbed by the mirrored shield.
Which logic frame of a 200 ms packet an action lands on matters; the shield must be up on the exact frame an attack arrives.
When grabbed use struggle; about ten packets of alternating presses frees you.
Each fight has one item (slingshot, explosive fruit, hammer or grapple line); press L.

move.en: 8-way camera-relative movement; *_step = held only the first half of the packet, *_f1/f3/f4 = held on one logic frame only (small alignment steps)

options.forward_step: forward held first half of packet
options.back_step: back held first half of packet
options.left_step: left held first half of packet
options.right_step: right held first half of packet
options.forward_left_step: forward left held first half of packet
options.forward_right_step: forward right held first half of packet
options.back_left_step: back left held first half of packet
options.back_right_step: back right held first half of packet
options.forward_f1: forward held on logic frame 1 only
options.forward_left_f1: forward left held on logic frame 1 only
options.forward_right_f1: forward right held on logic frame 1 only
options.forward_f3: forward held on logic frame 3 only
options.forward_left_f3: forward left held on logic frame 3 only
options.forward_right_f3: forward right held on logic frame 3 only
options.forward_f4: forward held on logic frame 4 only

act.en: One action per packet: slash, shield, roll/jump, item, struggle free, or camera step

options.shield: hold shield for the whole packet
options.shield_late: shield in second half of packet
options.shield_early: shield in first half of packet
options.struggle: mash to break free when grabbed

summary.en: A giant one-eyed spider queen in a cave that lays eggs, spawns larvae and slams, and can drop from the ceiling.

tell.en: She rears up, her eye turns red and a red fan fills in front of her (about 1.65 s).

effect.en: Hits inside the fan; can be blocked.

counter.en: Roll or side-hop out of the fan, then close in and slash.

tell.en: No warning; the body itself is the cue.

effect.en: Continuous contact damage.

counter.en: Stay at the edge of sword range.

tell.en: Egg sacs on the ceiling pulse red and the eye glows, about 3.5 s; a yellow ring marks where an egg will land.

effect.en: Eggs drop and hatch larvae.

counter.en: Step out of the yellow ring and clear the larvae.

tell.en: A larva crouches and flashes red; a red strip shows its lunge (about 1.5 s).

effect.en: Damages you if it lands.

counter.en: Side-hop off the strip or cut it down.

tell.en: She climbs the ceiling, a downward arrow appears at the screen edge, and she falls in about 1 s.

effect.en: Contact damage on landing.

counter.en: Roll away from the landing point.

summary.en: A giant lizard in a magma cave that breathes fire, rolls and swallows explosive fruit.

tell.en: He inhales: the mouth brightens and air streams in while a fire line on the ground fades in; about 5.9 s in total.

effect.en: A straight stream along the line; can be blocked.

counter.en: Step off the line, or use the inhale to attack.

tell.en: He curls into a ball glowing red; a red strip on the ground points to where he rolls (about 1.35 s).

effect.en: Damages on contact; cannot be blocked.

counter.en: Roll or side-hop away from the strip.

tell.en: No warning; lava pits glow.

effect.en: Touching the body or lava hurts.

counter.en: Stay out of lava and off his body.

tell.en: A fuse sparks; in the last ~1.2 s a flashing blast radius is drawn on the ground.

effect.en: The explosion hurts.

counter.en: Leave the circle; the fruit can also be fed into his mouth.

phases.en: Throw explosive fruit into his open mouth to stun him, then slash.

summary.en: A ghost-horse rider in a gallery who throws energy orbs and bats them back.

tell.en: He raises a trident and a green orb grows at its tip (about 1.25 s).

effect.en: The orb flies at you and hurts on hit.

counter.en: Slash the orb back with correct timing.

tell.en: He swings the trident to return it; the orb turns green again (about 0.4 s).

effect.en: The returned orb arrives fast and hurts.

counter.en: Hit it back again or roll aside.

tell.en: He leans back, cape and eyes turn red and a red strip points at you (about 1 s).

effect.en: A straight-line ram.

counter.en: Side-hop or roll off the strip.

phases.en: At low health he starts to charge.

summary.en: A fire dragon that pops in and out of burrows, with surfacing blasts, claws, fire and falling rocks.

tell.en: A hole glows and smokes with a ring; on a real surfacing the outer ring turns red, and he sometimes fakes then switches holes.

effect.en: Heavy knockback damage; cannot be blocked.

counter.en: Leave the ring when it turns red, then strike.

tell.en: A claw lifts and a red fan appears, brightening on the hit frame.

effect.en: Triggers when you come near.

counter.en: Leave the fan, then slash after the miss.

tell.en: Fire glows in the mouth and a ground fan appears (about 1.25 s).

effect.en: Fire damage in the fan; can be blocked.

counter.en: Leave the fan or raise the shield.

tell.en: He flies up, an arrow shows at the screen edge and red fans appear with the flames.

effect.en: Fire sprays toward you from the air.

counter.en: Run out of the fans.

tell.en: A red ring and shrinking outer ring mark the spot; the rock falls in about 1 s.

effect.en: Damages on impact; cannot be blocked.

counter.en: Roll out of the ring.

phases.en: At lower health surfacing and idle times shorten and attacks come faster.

summary.en: A giant water mass in a pool with a core hidden inside and tentacles that rise from the floor.

tell.en: A water ripple ring with a red outer ring appears at the root (about 3.5 s).

effect.en: Contact damage when it surfaces.

counter.en: Step out of the ring first.

tell.en: The water column glows red and a red strip fills as the swing counts down.

effect.en: Damages on hit; can be blocked.

counter.en: Leave the strip or roll.

tell.en: A red ring marks the grab point; when caught a tightening water ring appears (about 2 s wind-up).

effect.en: You take repeated damage while held.

counter.en: When caught, use struggle to break free in about ten packets.

tell.en: No warning; the core glows red even underwater.

effect.en: Touching the core hurts.

counter.en: Only close to sword range to hit it.

summary.en: Two witches, one flame and one frost, who fire flame or frost blasts; only one staff glows each time.

tell.en: The target sigil lights, the staff glows and a ground line connects to you; about 3.35 s before release, and only the chosen staff glows.

effect.en: High damage; cannot be blocked, but the mirrored shield absorbs it.

counter.en: Raise the mirrored shield on the frame it arrives.

tell.en: No warning.

effect.en: Touching a witch hurts.

counter.en: Do not stand on them.
